st: How renewable energy could win Festivalbar

sec.p: Solar, hydro, but above all wind. Only these sources saw an increase in electricity generated in 2020. The drop in coal was entirely absorbed by these three sources, with wind ruling the roost (+163 TWh, versus 148 and 78 for solar and hydro).

sec.t: ff.11.2 Is China a story of its own?
sec.p: Once again, China proves to be on another level. In 2021 it installed 227 GW of solar power, versus the 140 installed GLOBALLY the year before, the first pandemic year. As you can see from the chart, the linear trend of recent years has accelerated.

sec.t: ff.11.3 Robots lend us a hand
sec.p: Remember the ff where I talked about how robots will steal our jobs? Well, if in doing so they cause the accelerations above, so be it. It's probably thanks to systems like the ones in the video below, highly automated and safe, that installation costs have dropped so sharply…
The year that just ended also saw an untold number of records in the funding that went to basic research and to developing industrial systems for sustainable energy.
